title: Pueblo's $7 Million Empty Flight, Air Baltic Hides the Sick Bags, and American Fights a Refund It Clearly Owes
summary: A tiny Colorado airport gets a taxpayer-funded flight nobody's flying, Air Baltic's bankruptcy cost-cutting gets weirdly specific, and American Airlines goes to court over an $8,000 refund. Plus Avelo picks a fight at Dallas's newest airport, and a quick update on Spirit's fire sale.
